headline: Low interaction risk overall: no shared channels or write surfaces are exposed, so prompt injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are largely blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Agent A has no I/O surfaces or runnable interaction path, and Agent B has clipboard, stdin/stdout, files, MCP, and browser all false. With no shared communication channel, there is no plausible prompt-injection bridge between them.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared clipboard, file drop, or MCP server, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents disconnected from shared clipboard and file sync.
Do not add an MCP bridge without provenance filtering.
Recheck the pair if either agent becomes runnable.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent has network egress, and Agent B cannot read files or handle secrets; Agent A also touches no data classes. Without shared storage or outbound transport, there is no credible leakage path between them.
conditions: IF either agent gains filesystem read access or network egress, reassess leakage risk.
mitigations: Keep network egress disabled on both agents.
Review any future secret-handling scopes before enabling them.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Agent A exposes no write or execution surfaces, while Agent B cannot write files, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses. Because neither can mutate a shared resource, capability conflict is provably blocked in the current profiles.
conditions: IF Agent A is given write access to the same directory as Agent B, reassess conflict risk.
mitigations: Do not grant Agent A filesystem write access.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Agent A is a non-runnable course repo and Agent B is a non-runnable support agent scaffold, so there is no default action chain where B blindly executes A's outputs. Any cascade would require unusual orchestration not present here, and the blast radius is small.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding Agent A outputs into Agent B as authoritative inputs, reassess cascade risk.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Do not auto-forward outputs from A to B.
Keep both agents non-runnable unless needed.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes are touched by either agent, and neither profile requests secrets, OAuth scopes, or network egress. With no regulated data flow or residency mismatch shown, there is no compliance pathway to score.
conditions: IF regulated data is later introduced into either agent's workflow, reassess compliance risk.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of this pair.
Document any future retention or residency requirements.
Review compliance before enabling new data sources.
